authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Platts p. 1109 explicitly identifies Hindi mewā fruit with Persian mewa/mīwa. The existing Hindi mewa entry is independently recorded in Degener’s glossary. These whole mev- fruit words are provisionally linked through that attested Hindi donor; Persian, Pashto and other Indo-Aryan routes remain possible locally. Exact source form mevā is preserved. The donor locality is an attestation, not an assertion of historical transmission from that village.
